exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood recipients
exclusions.why_safe: The question only asks about St. Vincent regional hospital's received units. Other entities do not affect the hospital's stock.

exclusions.name: Blood wastage, expiration, or other losses
exclusions.why_safe: No evidence mentions any wastage or losses. The collection rate is 'usable units', and shipments are assumed to arrive intact. Excluding losses is safe because the evidence does not indicate any.

exclusions.name: Other collection drives or sources
exclusions.why_safe: The only source of blood for the hospital is the centre's shipments. No other drives or donations are mentioned.

exclusions.name: Friday collection before noon
exclusions.why_safe: The deadline is Friday noon. The centre is open 9 AM to 5 PM, but no shipment occurs on Friday. Any Friday collection would not be shipped before noon, so it cannot affect the hospital's stock by the deadline.

exclusions.name: Elena Cruz's actions
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control rates or schedules. Her actions do not change the number of units received.

The centre starts with 40 units, collects 12 units/hour for 8 hours on Monday (96 units) and 7 hours on Tuesday before 4 PM (84 units), total 220 units. Since 220 >= 150, this is resolved as true, but the exact stock after shipment is uncertain if other uses occur.
